items.text: Updates to the minion last hit presentation.
Item auto upgrade notification in match.
No longer buffs minions until 15 minutes into a match
Fixed % HP damage abilities dealing too much damage/gaining too much health from Totem of Ku
Gain Physical Protection and Magical Protection for each friendly or enemy god nearby.

items.detail: : Passive Meter has been updated with new Art with for better clarity

items.text: Fire a kiss projectile at an allied god to link a Soul Mate, giving you both increased movement speed, and reduce Kiss's cooldown. If the kiss hits an enemy god, they take Magical Damage, are Stunned, and your Soul Mate becomes Jealous, increasing their damage dealt. The Soul Mate gains 50% of your MP5 and 10% of your protections.

items.detail: : A locked-on to ally kiss will now hit enemies it hits along the way, if this happens, the full length cooldown will be applied
: if you were linked to an ally for 4s or longer when you switch to a new linked target, both allies will become jealous

items.text: Deal Magical Damage, Slow, and Push away enemies around you. If you have a Soul Mate, Deal Magical Damage, Slow, and Push away enemies around them as well. If an enemy is hit by both areas, they take reduced damage from the 2nd area.

items.detail: : Enemies hit by both areas of back off in a single fire will now be hit by 25% bonus damage

items.text: Fire a doves projectile that deals Magical Damage repeatedly over time to enemies hit. On fire, Aphrodite and her Soul Mate start healing repeatedly over time and have their active cooldowns decreased per tick.

items.detail: : INT scaling returns to the healing on Love Birds Scaling is higher scaling for Aphrodite than for her allies being healed by the effect

items.text: You and your Soul Mate become Damage Immune, CC Immune, and gain the Jealousy effect for a short duration.

items.detail: : Aphrodite can now refire this ability while the buff is active to fly to her allies location - she is untargetable while flying

items.text: Medusa suffers no movement penalty when strafing and half the movement penalty while backpedaling.
Medusa gains increased Attack Speed and augments her next 4 Basic Attacks, shooting vipers that poison the targets hit, dealing damage every 0.5s for 1.5s.

items.detail: : Each successful hit on an enemy god reduces the Cooldown of this ability by 0.5s.
: The Attack Speed stim scales with Strength.

items.text: Medusa spits acid that deals damage to the first enemy hit, which then sprays out in a cone behind them. Enemies hit have their Healing Taken reduced for 5s. Acid Spray will explode on statues Medusa has created.
Medusa slithers forward, dealing damage to all enemies she passes through. Medusa stops on the first enemy god hit, damaging and Rooting them.

items.detail: : Medusa can instantly destroy statues when colliding with them during this ability.

items.text: Medusa removes her mask, revealing her true face and delivering a powerful blast. Enemies are dealt damage and Stunned if they are looking at her or Slowed if they are not.

items.detail: : Statues are created when an enemy god is killed during any of the ability’s effects, including the Stun, Slow, or the damage.
: When a statue is destroyed, the Cooldown of Lacerate is reduced by 5s, Medusa gains a 10s Strength and Intelligence buff, and Medusa gains a permanent stack of Strength and Intelligence.

items.text: When you drop below 50% health, gain increased Strength and Lifesteal. This effect has a cooldown.

Fires a Magma projectile that deals Physical Damage and grants fuel per enemy hit. At max range the Magma persists and fired additional shard projectiles back to you, dealing Physical Damage to enemies. The shared returning is dependent on the rank of the ability.
Pele has 2 charges of this ability.

items.detail: : Spawn location of the return projectiles has been adjusted slightly so that gods hit at max range of the initial projectile will also be hit by the returning ones

items.text: Deal Physical Damage and Knock Up enemies around you. At rank 3 and 5 this area gains additional explosion areas, which deal Physical Damage and a smaller Knock Up.

items.detail: : Firing this ability while in the Amplified Stage of Magma Rush will cause Pele to dash a short distance before erupting

items.text: Repeatedly deal Physical Damage to nearby enemies and gain movement speed while this ability is active. Magma Rush uses Fuel for its duration and has no cooldown.
Reactivate this ability to amplify the effect, expending more fuel but dealing increased Physical Damage and gaining additional movement speed.

items.detail: : Pele now enters Magma Rush and gains the effects faster than in S1, but is locked out from cancelling the effect for the same duration as in S1

items.text: Become CC Immune then Dash forward dealing Physical Damage and Slowing the first enemy God hit, and firing a cone attack that deals Physical Damage to other enemies.
For the next 10 seconds or 4 attacks, every time you basic attack an enemy, you deal reduced damage and also fire a cone attack.

In CA5, we increased all gods Health per level stat by 15%. We are now reverting a portion of the nerf, which would equate to gods having only 10% greater Health per level than they would from that adjustment.
God Classes are slightly more spread out stat-wise - not nearly to the same extent Smite 1 is, but greater than in previous Smite 2 patches.
This adjustment does not include the Attack Speed stat

Silences now interrupt prefires, meaning you are unable to buffer into a Silence.

Ares No Escape now cripples enemies that he chains, meaning you are now unable to buffer movement abilities into his Ultimate. This ability will still cripple even when our CC Buffering tests are not active.

Hades Shroud of Darkness (Ability 2) will now Silence in addition to Fearing when used on a Blighted target. This will not impact Diminishing Return stacks. This is to make sure that getting the better version of the ability doesn't allow buffering when the base does not.
Be sure to complete our CC Buffering Survey if you've had a chance to play with the new feature!
